englishBoatLayers: Exact original boat pixels are clipped into runtime canvas sprites. A source-derived inpainted plate removes each baked silhouette before compositing the single bobbing boat. No duplicate boat image is overlaid on the original silhouette.
water: Bounded GPU refraction of original water pixels, surveyed regions plus color filtering; directional waterfall flow is a separate mask channel. Land/architecture use fixed sampling coordinates.
